title: 9. Prime Minister – Special Safeguards (VERY FREQUENTLY ASKED)

blocks.content:
Lokpal cannot inquire into matters relating to:
• National security
• Foreign relations
• Atomic energy
• Space

Such cases require approval of at least TWO-THIRDS of Lokpal members.

items: Memorize the 4 restricted areas: National Security, Foreign Relations, Atomic Energy, and Space.
Questions frequently test the specific fraction required for approval—remember it is TWO-THIRDS (2/3) of members, not a simple majority.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Lokpal cannot freely inquire into four specific sensitive matters regarding the Prime Minister.
The restricted domains include National Security, Foreign Relations, Atomic Energy, and Space.
Inquiries into these sensitive areas require a special voting threshold within the Lokpal body.
At least two-thirds of Lokpal members must approve before an inquiry into these matters can proceed.
